body: Suresh, following up on your interest in the corporate bulk thali. Given your current weekday lunch thali is at ₹149, I can draft a simple 3-item corporate menu structure for you to review. Want me to send that draft now?
rationale: Directly addresses the merchant's specific question about the corporate thali structure using the existing ₹149 price point as an anchor. Uses reciprocity by offering a ready-made draft to reduce the merchant's effort.

body: Padma, following up on your kids yoga plan — since we're in the lowest acquisition window (Apr-Jun), this is a perfect retention play for your existing Mylapore families rather than a new ad spend. What age group are you targeting first, 5-8 or 9-12? I'll tailor the 4-week curriculum and pricing structure based on your answer.
rationale: Leverages the 'active_planning' signal and recent conversation context. Uses the seasonal digest item to reframe the new program as a retention strategy (low acquisition window) rather than an acquisition cost. Asks a specific binary-ish question (age group) to move the planning forward with low friction.

body: Hi Aditya, it's Karim from Karim's Salon in Alambagh. We have a slot open for you tomorrow and would love to welcome you back. Since it's been a while, we're offering a haircut at ₹99 to get you started. Would you like to confirm a time for tomorrow?
rationale: Warm recall for a lapsed customer using the active haircut offer. Binary CTA simplifies the decision for a 20-25 year old. Specific price anchor (₹99) provides immediate value clarity.

body: Hi Riya, Beauty Lounge by Renu here. Aapka appointment kal scheduled hai. Please confirm your slot so we can prepare everything for you. Reply 1 to confirm, or 2 to reschedule.
rationale: Direct confirmation request for tomorrow's appointment. Uses Hindi-English code-mix per customer preference. Binary CTA for quick confirmation.

body: Ramesh, summer demand shift is live in Jaipur: ORS +40%, anti-fungal +45%, cold/cough -60%. Your CTR (4.5%) is already beating the peer median (3.8%), so shelf rotation is the only lever left. Which of these three categories do you want to prioritize for your 'Flat 20% OFF' banner this week?
rationale: Uses specific YoY demand deltas to justify the seasonal trigger. Leverages the merchant's above-peer CTR to frame shelf rotation as the next logical step. Asks a specific binary-choice question to drive engagement.

body: Meera, quick one — with 124 high-risk adults in your Lajpat Nagar cohort, are you currently running 3-month fluoride varnish recalls or sticking to the standard 6-month? JIDA's Oct issue (p.14) just showed a 38% drop in caries recurrence with the shorter interval in a 2,100-patient trial. Want me to pull the abstract and draft a patient-ed note for your high-risk list?
rationale: Uses the specific high-risk adult count (124) and JIDA citation to anchor the question. Leverages reciprocity by offering to draft the patient note, and asks the merchant a specific clinical question to engage their expertise.

body: Namaste Mr. Sharma, Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy (Malviya Nagar) se baat ho rahi hai. Aapke chronic medicines (Metformin, Atorvastatin, Telmisartan) ka refill due hai. Last refill 26 March ko hua tha, toh stock abhi khatam hone wala hai. Aapke liye morning delivery slot available hai. Kya aap confirm karna chahenge?
rationale: Urgency based on stock running out soon (implied by 'due' and last refill date). Uses Hindi-English code-mix as per preference. Binary CTA for confirmation of delivery.

body: Hi Vivaan, this is Dr. Sameer from Bright Smile Dental, Indiranagar. It's been 6 months since your last visit (April 1), so your routine dental check-up and cleaning recall is due. We have slots available this week: Tuesday 11am or Thursday 5pm. The standard cleaning is currently available at ₹299. Would you like to book one of these slots?
rationale: Standard 6-month recall trigger for a lapsed customer. Uses specific last-visit date and active offer price to anchor specificity. Multi-choice slot CTA facilitates immediate booking.

body: Meera, Smile Studio opened 1.3km away (Lajpat Nagar) on Apr 8 with a ₹199 cleaning offer. Data shows price-led entry in dental rarely shifts high-value cohorts; your 124 high-risk adults are better served by clinical differentiation than a price war. Your CTR is 2.1% vs peer median 3.0%, so let's leverage the JIDA Oct 2026 study (N=2100) showing 38% lower caries recurrence with 3-month fluoride recall. I can draft a 'High-Risk Care' WhatsApp blast for your 124 patients + a Google post highlighting this evidence. Want me to send the drafts?
rationale: Contrarian advice to avoid price war, anchored in specific competitor data and a high-impact clinical study relevant to the merchant's high-risk cohort. Uses loss aversion (losing high-value patients to a low-price competitor) and effort externalization (drafting the content).

body: Suresh, a new competitor just opened in Indiranagar. Here's the contrarian play: don't chase them with discounts. Your weekday thali is already pulling 18 orders/day, and data shows weeknight matches drive +18% covers while Saturdays drop 12%. Stick to your weekday strength. Want me to draft a 'Weekday Thali Special' WhatsApp blast for your existing 4,200 customers to lock in loyalty before they try the new place?
rationale: Uses competitor opening as trigger but pivots to defensive retention using specific performance data (18 orders/day, 4200 customers) and seasonal insights. Loss aversion (locking in loyalty) + effort externalization (drafting the blast).

body: Hi Lakshmi, quick one: with balayage searches up 45% YoY, is that your top ask this week at Studio11? I'll turn your answer into a ready-to-post Google update. Takes 2 min.
rationale: Uses the specific 45% YoY trend signal to anchor the question. Leverages reciprocity by offering to draft the post immediately upon receiving the answer.

body: Suresh, quick one before we finalize the corporate thali: which 2-3 items from your current menu get the most repeat orders from office-goers in Indiranagar? I'll use that to build the bulk menu + a 1-line WhatsApp pitch for HR managers. Takes 2 min.
rationale: Leverages the merchant's recent intent to create a corporate thali by asking for specific menu insights (asking-the-merchant). Offers immediate value (drafting the pitch) in exchange for low-effort input (reciprocity).

body: Hi Rashmi, it's Karthik from PowerHouse Fitness in HSR Layout. We noticed it's been 57 days since your last session on Feb 28. We miss having you in the gym! Since you were focused on weight loss before, we'd love to help you get back on track with a fresh start. We have 2 weekday evening slots open this week: Tuesday 6pm or Thursday 7pm. Would you like to book a free trial class to ease back in?
rationale: Warm, non-guilt-tripping winback leveraging the customer's specific lapse duration (57 days) and previous focus (weight loss). Offers specific weekday evening slots matching her preference and uses the active '3 FREE Trial Classes' offer as a low-friction re-entry point.

body: Hi Reyansh, it's Dr. Asha from Asha Dental Care, Sector 17. It's been about 6 months since your last visit (April 1st), so your routine scaling and fluoride check-up is due. We have a special offer for returning patients: Dental Cleaning @ ₹299. Would you like to book a slot this week?
rationale: Warm, non-guilt-tripping recall anchored on the specific last visit date (April 1st) and the active ₹299 offer. Uses binary_yes_no CTA to minimize friction for a churned customer.

body: Hi Reyansh, Daily Care Medicos Alambagh yahan se. Aapka last visit 1 April 2026 tha, ab 6 mahine ho gaye hain. Humare paas abhi Flat 20% OFF medicines ka offer chal raha hai. Kya aap check-up ya refill ke liye aana chahenge? Reply 1 for Yes, 2 for No.
rationale: Warm recall message using specific last visit date and active offer. Binary CTA for low-friction re-engagement. Hi-en mix language honored.
